note: Every value is either 'sourced' (with a citation) or 'pending' (with the dataset to pull it from). Nothing is filled in by guesswork. Slope is defined at a ~5 km baseline to match the Earth grid. Roughness (sub-km) is not comparable across worlds at these resolutions, so v0.2 uses relief_55km_m (elevation std dev over ~55 km) instead.

targets.name: Jezero crater floor
targets.why: Perseverance landing site; ancient lake and river delta

thermal_inertia_si.source: Martinez et al. 2023, JGR Planets, 'Surface Energy Budget, Albedo and Thermal Inertia at Jezero Crater, Mars, as Observed From the Mars 2020 MEDA Instrument' (180 = sand dune, 605 = bedrock-dominated)

albedo.source: MGS TES Lambert albedo, USGS Astrogeology global mosaic (7410 m, 8 px/deg), mean over a ~55 km box. Earth side uses MODIS white-sky shortwave albedo; both are broadband surface reflectance.

lst_day_c.source: Mars Climate Database v6.2 (LMD/OU/IAA/ESA/CNES), climatology average solar scenario, surface temperature at local time 10.5 h, mean over the Mars year (Ls 0-345 in 15 deg steps). Local times chosen to match NASA Terra/MODIS overpass (~10:30 / 22:30).

lst_night_c.source: Mars Climate Database v6.2 (LMD/OU/IAA/ESA/CNES), climatology average solar scenario, surface temperature at local time 22.5 h, mean over the Mars year (Ls 0-345 in 15 deg steps). Local times chosen to match NASA Terra/MODIS overpass (~10:30 / 22:30).

slope_deg.source: Computed by TwinWorlds from MGS MOLA MEGDR 16 ppd (NASA PDS), resampled to 5.55 km pixels, mean over a 55 km box

ndvi.source: No vegetation on Mars (target value by definition)

relief_55km_m.source: Computed by TwinWorlds from MGS MOLA MEGDR 16 ppd: std dev of elevation within a 55 km box

lst_swing_c.source: Derived: lst_day_c minus lst_night_c (Mars Climate Database v6.2)

targets.name: Shackleton crater rim (lunar south pole)
targets.coords_note: Crater centre; rim/ridge sites lie within ~10 km. Refine from Artemis III candidate regions
targets.why: Artemis base candidate; near-constant low sun, cold traps

lst_day_c.source: Literature estimate for near-constantly illuminated rim sites: -50 +/- 10 C (Bussey, Robinson & Spudis 2004, LPSC XXXV, as cited on Wikipedia 'Shackleton (crater)'). Not a direct Diviner measurement.

lst_night_c.source: No regular night on the rim: it is sunlit 80-90% of the time (Spudis et al. 1995). Diviner's 22:30 local-time value for this 1 deg polar cell, -194.8 C, is dominated by the permanently shadowed crater floor, so it is not used for the rim

albedo.source: LRO LOLA LDAM 4 ppd normal albedo at 1064 nm (Lemelin et al. 2016), mean of the 1 deg cell -89.5, 129.5. Single wavelength: approximate comparison with Earth/Mars broadband albedo

slope_deg.source: Computed by TwinWorlds from NASA PDS LRO LOLA LDEM 16 ppd, re-gridded to a flat 5.55 km polar grid, mean over a 55 km box (box includes the crater itself)

sun_elevation_deg.source: Computed from latitude: sun stays within ~1.5 deg of horizon at the pole

relief_55km_m.source: Computed by TwinWorlds from LRO LOLA LDEM 16 ppd: std dev of elevation within a 55 km box

illumination_pct.source: Spudis et al. 1995, LPSC XXVI, as cited on Wikipedia 'Shackleton (crater)'

lst_swing_c.source: No regular day-night cycle on the rim (sunlit 80-90% of the time), so a day-night swing is not defined

targets.name: Mare Tranquillitatis pit
targets.coords_note: Pit location as reported by LROC; verify before demo
targets.why: Lava tube skylight; thermally stable shelter for a base

lst_day_c.source: Horvath et al. 2022, Geophysical Research Letters, doi:10.1029/2022GL099710 (surrounding surface daytime high, LRO Diviner)

lst_night_c.source: Horvath et al. 2022, GRL (surrounding surface nighttime low)

pit_shade_temp_c.source: Horvath et al. 2022, GRL (permanently shadowed part of the pit stays near 17 C)

pit_depth_m.source: Horvath et al. 2022 / NASA release (pit roughly 100 m deep)

albedo.source: LRO LOLA LDAM 4 ppd normal albedo at 1064 nm (Lemelin et al. 2016), mean of the 1 deg cell 8.5, 33.5. Single wavelength: approximate comparison with Earth/Mars broadband albedo

slope_deg.source: Computed by TwinWorlds from LRO LOLA LDEM 16 ppd (NASA PDS), resampled to 5.55 km pixels, mean over a 55 km box

relief_55km_m.source: Computed by TwinWorlds from LRO LOLA LDEM 16 ppd: std dev of elevation within a 55 km box

lst_swing_c.source: Derived from Horvath et al. 2022 (GRL): 127 C day minus -173 C night
